financial_anchor.metric: June-quarter 2026 revenue and GAAP income from operations
financial_anchor.caveat: GAAP operating income includes an RMB4.458bn goodwill impairment and a provision related to the European Commission fine; quarter-only basis.

ai_claim.claim: Alibaba reported external Alibaba Cloud revenue growth of 45% and AI-related product revenue of RMB12.376bn, with triple-digit year-over-year growth for a twelfth consecutive quarter.
ai_claim.stage: E2 issuer-reported external cloud/AI-product demand; internal productivity and E4 unproven
ai_claim.scope: External cloud demand only; not Alibaba internal productivity.
ai_claim.limitation: External revenue growth is not AI compute growth, internal commerce productivity, causal margin lift or retained cash.

strongest_counterevidence.claim: profit fell sharply while capex surged.
strongest_counterevidence.limitation: Does not itself disprove the scoped mechanism.

rights_limit: Public terms do not prove universal training or pooled cross-customer reuse; enterprise schedules were unavailable.
materiality_summary: RMB758.05m = 5% of June-quarter 2026 GAAP income from operations of RMB15.161bn. This is a quarter-only, pre-tax screen and is NOT_COMPARABLE with the annual benefit illustration; no annualization is assumed.

arithmetic.inputs: pool RMB60bn eligible internal sales, service and operations cost (assumption); efficiency 8%; realization 50%; retained share 40%; recurring cost RMB10bn
arithmetic.formula: eligible cost × efficiency × realization × retained share − recurring AI expense
